title: Reen Probable NDE 3422
content: I was in a car, with my friend. He wasn’t driving carefully, so we had an accident. The car turned over six times! My friend died on the spot, but he tried to protect me so he surrounded my head with his hands before his death. My heart stopped for 12 minutes.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: No Accident Life threatening event, but not clinical death
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Yes I lost awareness of my body
elements.How did your highest level of consciousn: Normal consciousness and alertness I was conscious.
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning
elements.Did you seem to be aware of things going: Yes, and the facts have been checked out
elements.Did you see, or feel surrounded by, a br: A light clearly of mystical or other-worldly origin
elements.What emotions did you feel during the ex: I felt that death was coming up
elements.Did you feel a sense of harmony or unity: I felt united or one with the world
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control I watched all the nice moments in my life. I had so few nice moments, that I learned to have fun and to live life in the right way.
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will
elements.God, Spiritual and Religion: point of no return? I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will God, Spiritual and Religion
elements.Did you seem to encounter a mystical bei: I encountered a definite being, or a voice clearly of mystical or unearthly origin
elements.Concerning our Earthly lives other than: ally saw them Concerning our Earthly lives other than Religion
elements.Have your relationships changed specific: Yes After the death of my love I don’t care about love any more. All I want is it to get fun in this life.
elements.After the NDE: tionships changed specifically because of your experience? Yes After the death of my love I don’t care about love any more. All I want is it to get fun in this life. After the NDE
elements.Was the experience difficult to express: Yes I returned to life after death.
elements.What did you believe about the reality o: Experience was definitely real My family told that they decided to put my body in the fridge
